name: Hanaoka Makio
source:
The cheeky and carefree popular young author.

A popular young novelist known for his delicate scenery descriptions, Makio Hanaoka’s sensitivity stems from him growing up on an island. His honest, friendly personality and charm help him blend and connect easily with others.
